Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 07-Feb-2025 (01:00 PM - 04:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.Tech. (CORE STREAM) EXAMINATIONS - FEBRUARY 2025  
  SUBJECT: PHY_1071- ENGINEERING PHYSICS  
  (MAKEUP)  
  Engineering Physics [PHY-1071]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                         Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               What is attenuation in an optical fiber? What are the different types of attenuation processes in          (4)  
  optical fiber?  
1B)               The ratio of population of atoms between upper state to ground state atoms is 1.059 x 10-30. Find          (4)  
  the wavelength of the light emitted at 300 K.  
1C)               Why is the pumping system important to obtain a laser?                                                     (2)  
2A)               What is phase speed and group speed for a quantum particle. Derive a relation between phase                (4)  
  speed and group speed.  
2B)               A blackbody at 7500 K consists of an opening of diameter 0.05 mm, looking into an oven. Find the           (4)  
  number of photons per second escaping the hole and having wavelengths between 500 nm and  
  501 nm.  
2C)               Sketch schematically the graph of intensity of radiation vs wavelength from a blackbody, at two            (2)  
  different temperatures (two graphs with the same scale).  
  Find the peak wavelength of the Sun with a surface temperature of 5800 K. Wien's constant is  
  2.898 × 10-3 m.K.  
  
3A)               Derive an expression for density-of-states function for an electron in a metal.                            (4)  
3B)               A quantum simple harmonic oscillator consists of an electron bound by a restoring force                    (4)  
  proportional to its position relative to certain equilibrium points. The proportionality constant is k =  
  9.1 N/m. What is the wavelength of light emitted if the harmonic oscillator de-excites from the  
  second excited state to the first excited state.  
3C)               When an electron and a proton of the same kinetic energy encounter a potential barrier of the same (2)  
  height and width, which one of them will tunnel through the barrier more easily? Why?  
4A)               Describe two main characteristics of ferroelectric substances. Sketch the polarization versus electric (4)  
  field curve and show the saturation and remanent polarization points.  
4B)               Calculate the induced dipole moment per unit volume (i.e., polarization) of the helium gas when            (4)  
  placed in an electric field of 6 x 10 5 V/m. The polarizability of helium is 0.18 x 10-40 Fm2 and the  
  concentration of helium atoms is 2.6 x 1025 /m3 . Also, calculate the separation of positive and  
  negative charges in each atom.  
4C)               Electrons are not charge carriers in superconductors. Justify the statement.                               (2)  
5A)               Discuss the properties and applications of metallic glasses.                                               (4)  
5B)               An HCl molecule is excited to its first rotational energy level, corresponding to J = 1. If the distance   (4)  
  between its nuclei is r o = 0.1275 nm, what is the angular speed of the molecule about its centre of  
  mass ?  
  -27kg.  
  Given: Mass (in atomic mass unit) of H is 1 amu and Cl is 35 amu. Take 1 amu as 1.66x 10  
  Page #1

5C)   How does the uncertainty principle explain why it's impossible to know both the exact position and   (2)  
  exact momentum of a particle simultaneously?  
  
  
  -----End-----
